title: Hammer & Screw Jam
description: Unscrew bolts from overlapping steel plates and wooden boards in exact sequence so every heavy plank tumbles cleanly off the wall.
controls: Tap a screw to pick it up, then tap an open hole to relocate it until all boards drop free.

zh-CN.title: 玩了个锤子打螺丝
zh-CN.description: 微信热榜超火打螺丝玩了个锤子：拆下螺丝挪进空洞，让层层卡住的木板铁片哗啦啦全部掉落，极度上头解压！
zh-CN.controls: 点击选中螺丝并移入空闲螺孔，巧妙腾位让所有被卡住的木板全部掉落清空。
